correctness.rationale: The outgoing Green kernel produces reflection-zero equation exp(2ikL)=-(U/V)(1-gV)/(1+gU) with g=i/(2t sin k). Moduli force U²=V². For V=-U roots are k=m*pi/L; for V=U, phase f(k)=Lk+arctan(U/(2t sin k)) crosses exactly L or L-1 odd-half-pi levels depending on |U|<2t/L. Chebyshev equation and implicit differentiation at x=±1 prove edge loss and square-root coefficient. Independent Chebyshev-root check found all 96 expected finite cases for L<=12 and 8 strengths. Only propagating k in (0,pi) counted; band edges excluded.
residual_risks: Finite independent calculations do not establish untested infinite cases; unrestricted conclusions rest on proof lemmas.
